email.verify_body:
Hello {name},

Please confirm your email to activate your account on the Ministry of Economy & Tourism careers portal.

{link}

The link works for 48 hours. If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.
email.reset_body:
Hello {name},

We received a request to reset the password of your careers portal account. Choose a new password here.

{link}

The link works for one hour and can be used once. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your password stays the same.
asm.title: My Assessments
asm.empty_body: When a job you applied for includes a test, it appears here and we email you.
asm.rule_sections: Sections are taken in order. When a section's time ends, or when you finish it, it closes and you cannot return to it.
asm.rule_save: Your answers are saved as you go. If you lose your connection, open the test again to continue.
asm.rule_timer: The timer keeps running if you leave the page.
asm.rule_own: Answer on your own, without help from others.
asm.ready: I have read the instructions and I am ready to start.
asm.confirm_section: You will not be able to return to this section.
asm.confirm_submit: You will not be able to change your answers after submitting.

asm.time_up: Time is up for this section. Your answers were saved.
asm.done_body: Thank you. Your answers have been submitted. We will contact you about the next steps.

Hello {name},

As part of your application, please complete the {test} on the Ministry of Economy & Tourism careers portal by {deadline} (UAE time).

{link}

Sign in with your careers portal account to start. Before you begin, make sure you have a stable connection and enough time to finish.
